readme:
# Telegram Channel Post Details API Returns one public Telegram channel post, parsed from the web embed view. It needs the channel username (`channel`) and the numeric post ID (`post_id`). The response includes the post text, media links, view count, and reactions. ## Use cases - Read the full text and photo links of a single announcement from a public channel. - Record the view count and reaction counts of one post at the time you call it. - Check whether a post is forwarded or replies to another post. - Build a link to a post from its `channel` and `id` and confirm the post exists. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/telegram/web/post-detail" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"channel": "durov", "post_id": 510}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `channel` | string | Yes | Channel username (required). | | `post_id` | integer | Yes | Post ID (required, auto-incremented integer within the channel). | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "author": "Pavel Durov", "channel": "durov", "date": "2026-05-12T17:28:39+00:00", "forwarded_from": null, "id": 510, "is_forwarded": false, "link_preview": null, "media": { "has_unsupported": true, "photos": [ "https://cdn4.telesco.pe/file/iw0nUCyqIulL0q3pX-lSNo9-_oaB0eX3MMQgjzDggf_QZEMrMic…" ], "videos": [] }, "reactions": [ { "count": "8.25K", "emoji": "⭐", "paid": true } ], "reply_to": null, "text": "🌍 With 400 validators across 6 continents, TON is one of the most decentralized …", "text_html": "🌍 With 400 validators across 6 continents, TON is one of the most decentralized …" } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `text / text_html` | Post body as plain text and as HTML. The HTML version keeps line breaks as `
` tags. | | `date` | Publication time of the post in ISO 8601 format with a UTC offset, such as `2026-05-12T17:28:39+00:00`. | | `type` | Kind of post. The example post is an `album`, which holds more than one photo. | | `media.photos[] / media.videos[]` | Lists of media URLs attached to the post. `videos` is empty in the example. | | `media.has_unsupported` | `true` when the post holds media that the embed view could not parse. | | `reactions[].emoji / reactions[].count` | Reaction emoji and how many people used it. Counts are shortened strings such as `8.25K`. The emoji can be an empty string. | | `reactions[].paid` | `true` for a paid reaction. The `⭐` reaction in the example has this flag set. | | `views` | View count of the post as a shortened string, such as `3.86M`. | | `is_forwarded / forwarded_from / reply_to` | Show whether the post is forwarded or a reply. All three are empty or `false` in the example. | | `url` | Public `t.me` link to the post. | ## Notes - Take `channel` from the `t.me` link of the channel, without the `@`. `post_id` is the integer at the end of the post URL. - `views` and `reactions[].count` are strings with `K` or `M` suffixes, so parse them before you do math. - To list recent posts and find IDs, call [Telegram Channel Posts](/apis/telegram/web/channel-posts). - To read replies to a post, use [Telegram Post Comments](/apis/telegram/web/post-comments). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Telegram Batch Channel Info](/apis/telegram/web/batch-channel-info): Returns basic channel profile details including title, description, and verified status for multiple public Telegram channels at once. - [Telegram Channel Info](/apis/telegram/web/channel-info): Returns public metadata for a Telegram channel, including title, description, verified status, and username, using the public web preview. - [Telegram Channel Posts](/apis/telegram/web/channel-posts): Get a public Telegram channel's recent posts: text, media, forwards, replies, link previews, reactions, views and time, with cursor pagination.
